motifs.name: upper_gnarled_pine_trunk
motifs.description: Isolate the upper central gnarled pine trunk and branch junction, beginning below the top seal area: dark twisted trunk, knotted forks, broken side twigs, small clustered pine needles, and pale reserve edges around the ink.
must_preserve: heavy black trunk strokes with dry-brush breaks
pale ink-wash halos along trunk edges
motifs.prompt: Imported from a ChatGPT Image motif-bank sheet and converted to transparent PNG.

motifs.name: left_winter_saplings
motifs.description: Isolate the sparse leafless saplings at the left-middle side, with pale reserve stems, thin black branch tips, and small clustered ink accents; exclude nearby red seal marks.
must_preserve: small dark ink dots at branch bases
soft gray wash around the stems
motifs.prompt: Imported from a ChatGPT Image motif-bank sheet and converted to transparent PNG.

motifs.name: right_horizontal_pine_spray
motifs.description: Isolate the rightward horizontal pine branch in the middle register, including its thin arcing branch line, drooping needle clusters, small dark foliage masses, and pale wash outline.
must_preserve: soft pale edge wash following the bough
motifs.prompt: Imported from a ChatGPT Image motif-bank sheet and converted to transparent PNG.

motifs.name: perched_pheasant
motifs.description: Isolate the full pheasant perched on the rock, including head, beak, eye ring, neck collar, patterned body, folded wing, scaled breast marks, long tapering tail, and feet where visible; exclude the supporting rock except where visually inseparable at the feet.
must_preserve: sharp beak and circular eye detail
dark neck collar and spotted throat
repeating scalloped feather pattern on back and wing
fine ink linework defining feather layers
motifs.prompt: Imported from a ChatGPT Image motif-bank sheet and converted to transparent PNG.

motifs.name: central_perch_rock
motifs.description: Isolate the pale central rock mass beneath and behind the pheasant, including its angular top ledge, dark vertical ink fissures, gray washes, and broken contour lines; do not include the bird body or bamboo spray.
must_preserve: dry-brush black texture at the base
broken ink outlines along rock edges
motifs.prompt: Imported from a ChatGPT Image motif-bank sheet and converted to transparent PNG.

motifs.name: lower_right_bamboo_spray
motifs.description: Isolate the bamboo and twig spray emerging from the right side of the lower rock, including long narrow leaves, jointed stems, angular branchlets, and scattered dark ink accents.
must_preserve: pointed bamboo leaves in black ink
contrast between dark leaves and pale background wash
motifs.prompt: Imported from a ChatGPT Image motif-bank sheet and converted to transparent PNG.

motifs.name: foreground_rock_bank_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the bottom foreground rock bank and grasses: broad pale rock surfaces, dark contour ridges, reed-like grass strokes at lower left, and gray wash texture across the stone.
must_preserve: reed and grass strokes at lower left
irregular dark rock accents and cracks
